deploy-bot: Deploy attempt to prod (environment: dedicated-prod) initiated for tag v2.14.0 (commit: abc1234). CI gate result: FAILED — blocking rollout. Failing checks: integration-tests (12 failed), perf-smoke (timeout). CI details: https://ci.redwood.example/commits/abc1234

jamal: Ack — thanks for the heads up. Any obvious failures in the logs?

deploy-bot: Quick excerpt from failing job logs:
```
FAILED tests/test_session_reconnect.py::test_reconnect_three_nodes
AssertionError: Expected status 200, got 500
  File "/workspace/tests/test_session_reconnect.py", line 78, in test_reconnect_three_nodes
    assert resp.status_code == 200
TimeoutError: grpc call timed out after 30s
```
Also perf-smoke hit `timeout after 600s` on p95 latency for grpc endpoints.

linh: That smells like the connection pooling change from PR #4521 — it touched `session_manager` and the reconnect logic. I saw one flaky in staging earlier but didn't dig in.

alex: Can we pin the prod rollout back to v2.13.9 until we have a fix? We should honor the change window and avoid pushing a rollback during the customer demo at 20:30 UTC.

jamal: +1. Plan: hold/cancel this deploy, open a rollback PR to pin prod to v2.13.9 and a hotfix branch from v2.13.9 with the revert/patch. @linh can you take lead on the debug/fix? I'll create the PRs and the incident ticket.

linh: I'm on it. I'll bisect locally — if it's the pooling change I'll revert that commit and run quick smoke. ETA ~30m for initial triage, 90m for a hotfix release candidate.

ops-sre-bot: Ticket INF-4126 created: "prod deploy blocked by CI gate — v2.14.0". Rollback PR: https://git.redwood.example/pr/4987. Hotfix draft: https://git.redwood.example/pr/4988. Change window flagged: hold any deploys to prod until CI green and triage complete. Notifying oncall and release managers.

jamal: Release notes / changelog update: mark v2.14.0 as BLOCKED due to CI gate failures and add regression note for connection pooling. @marketing please hold public announcement until we confirm a safe rollout.

deploy-bot: Deployment cancelled by CI gate for tag v2.14.0. Prod remains on v2.13.9. Will auto-retry if CI passes on requeue or will await manual re-run after fix. Logs and links posted above.
